products.note: Meeting analytics AI; engagement scoring; wellness insights; behavioral data privacy

profile_text.body:
Read is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA. The company describes itself as "the fastest growing AI meeting assistant, ever," offering real-time transcription, smart summaries, and AI-powered search and discovery across meetings, messages, emails, CRM systems, and documents. Its site positions the product as platform-agnostic, connecting across a range of third-party tools to deliver unified insights wherever users work.

The company's primary product, Read.ai, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and focuses on meeting analytics, engagement scoring, wellness insights, and behavioral data privacy. The site describes Read as an AI copilot capable of transforming meetings, emails, and messages into summaries and instant answers across devices.

The held facts do not include any litigation or SEC filings associated with Read. The MCP entries associated with the company in the registry are not directly tied to Read.ai's own product line, reflecting unrelated third-party servers that share keyword overlap with the company name.
